the lobby looks way nicer than the marriott i stayed at before, but honestly it's just okay overall for the price i paid. the whole place feels a bit off compared to what i expected.

location is super convenient being right downtown near all the main spots. the bed was comfy and the tv setup was cool, but the decor feels a bit dated and tired. the lobby area was really relaxing and had a nice vibe throughout. stayed here just over the weekend while visiting family in town.

the spot is just perfect for getting downtown without any hassle. loved the modern lobby design with those cool lighting accents everywhere. everything was spotless and the staff made check-in super smooth.

just booked a stay here a few days back for a quick getaway. the staff went above and beyond to get me settled in and even remembered my name from check-in. being so close to downtown made getting around a total breeze.

who else loves finding a solid stay without breaking the bank? sure the decor is a little dated but the rate was great and the loyalty perks made it worth it. location is kinda just average for what i needed.

Honestly, the evening snacks were top-notch quality. They had plenty of style options to pick from, though the coffee quality was a bit weak. Honestly, the beds were so cozy, the place was spotless, and the rate was a total steal for what you get. Being right downtown made getting to everything super easy. mixed feelings about this place, the decor is just kinda plain but the room was surprisingly spacious. though, the coffee and pastries were a total steal for the price. staff were super nice and helped me out right away when i needed extra towels.

the bed was super soft and the pillows made for a great night's sleep. there was a decent mix of food options but prices were a bit high even though the coffee was actually pretty good. got a really nice deal on the nightly rate through their loyalty program.

The overall vibe was okay, but the modern lighting fixtures actually look GREAT and everything feels pretty HIGH quality. Honestly, this spot was a solid choice for our recent getaway. The decor was a bit outdated, yet the condition of the place was surprisingly GOOD.

just pulled in and the spot right off the highway is super handy for grabbing stuff nearby. they had some decent coffee and a few pastries but honestly the options were kinda limited for what i expected. though the actual location got kinda sketchy at night so i'd think twice about walking around after dark.
The room was spotless, spacious, and made for a seriously restful sleep. The pool access is surprisingly affordable and the modern decor really stands out.

is it just me or is this spot perfectly tucked away near the highway but still quiet? the bed and mini-fridge were worth every penny for the price we paid last night. yeah the halls smelled a bit stale but honestly the rates are fair and the build quality is solid. the gym equipment was okay, nothing fancy but it got the job done. charging my phone at the desk for extra wasn't too costly at all. getting a room this cheap with such a cozy mattress is a total steal. just grabbed some coffee before heading out to the meeting down the street.

Heads up, the team made check-in a breeze and were super helpful. Just stayed for a couple of nights and the bed was ridiculously comfortable.

after trying a few other chains lately, this place was a bit of a curveball compared to my usual spots. the lobby design felt a bit outdated with those heavy curtains, yet the seating areas were surprisingly plush and cozy. i was just passing through town for a quick family visit when i decided to book a room here. the folks helping out during check-in were genuinely friendly and got me sorted in no time. the bathroom looked clean enough, the bed setup was nice, and the price tag was totally reasonable for what you get. overall quality was pretty high and the vibe was just right for a short stay. the furniture quality seemed solid but the carpet had some weird stains and there were a few missing items in the drawer. the location was just okay, sitting right in the middle of nowhere with not much to walk to. the cost for the room was a bit steep given everything else. the breakfast spread had some odd choices and the prices were a bit high for the food, but at least they had plenty of variety. i remember thinking about skipping breakfast until i saw the spread. the extra towels and the free wifi were a nice touch, and the value was good considering the perks. luckily the spot was actually pretty convenient for getting to the highway later on. i ended up staying an extra night since it was so handy. the room itself was well kept, super comfortable, and definitely worth the money spent.
We stumbled upon this spot while driving and loved how close it was to the main highway, making our morning commute a breeze.

Ok so I just booked a room here for a quick weekend trip. The place was spotless and the overall vibe felt really high quality. Plus the coffee maker was broken and there wasn't even a hairdryer in the closet. Grabbed some pancakes at breakfast and they were actually pretty tasty.

the breakfast was a total mess and way overpriced for what you get. i was really hoping to grab something quick before heading out to the convention. luckily the check-in went smooth enough even though i had to wait a bit. being right downtown made getting everywhere super easy though.

I really enjoyed how cozy and comfortable the bed felt after a long travel day. The breakfast spread was surprisingly good with plenty of variety to pick from. The price was fair for the amenities offered, even if the lobby design felt a bit dated and the place was just okay.

If you're looking for a spot that's super close to the highway, this place hits the mark perfectly. The hallways were spotless and the beds felt surprisingly cozy after a long drive. My suite had some grime in the corner, but the mattress was great and the color scheme just looked off. The gym equipment was top notch and the lounge area was really comfortable for a quick snack.

the furniture in the room felt kinda dated and the layout was awkward. my family had just checked in after a long drive so we were all pretty exhausted. we were just looking for a quick bite to eat before crashing for the night. the breakfast buffet had tons of style options but the omelets were bland and the prices were okay.
The sleek lobby design and top-notch amenities made our quick stay enjoyable, even though the cost was just okay.
mixed feelings about this place honestly, but the crew was super helpful getting me settled in. just dropped by a few nights back and the coffee in the lobby was actually decent for a change.
Ever wonder why the breakfast buffet looks SO tempting yet the waffles taste like cardboard? The new ergonomic desks are PERFECT and the space was spotless, all for a price that actually makes sense.

seriously glad we picked this spot because it's super close to everything we wanted to see the bed was okay but honestly the furniture felt pretty solid and new everything in the room was spotless though the mini fridge kinda smells funky breakfast was just average but they had plenty of options and the waffles were actually good since i travel a ton for work i really appreciate when a place just gets it right without trying too hard

The breakfast buffet was just okay, nothing special but not terrible either. While the carpet in the hallway needed some vacuuming, the price was surprisingly reasonable and the pool area was a nice bonus. For the money, the bed was incredibly plush and the whole setup felt like a great value.
The value was fantastic for the spotless, well-equipped room I got just a couple of nights back.

if you're looking for a spot to crash without breaking the bank, the price for the room was just about what you'd expect.

reviews.text: If you're looking for a place where the team really goes out of their way, this spot definitely delivers on that front. The bed was just okay but honestly, the price we paid for the room felt like a steal compared to other options nearby. The lobby layout feels pretty standard with some generic artwork hanging on the walls. Unfortunately, the checkout process dragged on forever despite asking for a quick exit.

honestly the breakfast prices were a steal and the food quality was great, though they didn't have too many style options. the room quality was kinda lacking but at least the cleanliness was spotless. i loved the design features of the lobby but the overall prices felt high for what you get, and the place was just okay on cleanliness. the facilities design was a bit outdated yet the comfort was top notch and the prices for the gym were fair. i was traveling with my family and we needed a place that could handle our crazy schedule. the miscellaneous snacks were surprisingly good and there were plenty of style options available in the bar area. the location was perfect since it was close to everything we wanted to see. we ended up grabbing dinner nearby just to try something different before heading back. the pool area had some really cool design features that made the whole space feel special. service was generally excellent from the moment we arrived until we left. paying for the extra amenities was totally worth the low prices charged. we spent most of our time exploring the city and only came back to sleep. there were lots of style options for our meals but the quality dipped on the second night and the prices stayed low. room prices were a bit steep and the design features felt cheap, but the cleanliness was actually really good.

heads up before you book this spot since the whole vibe was a letdown. we rolled in late after a long drive and just wanted a quiet place to crash. the room amenities were basic at best but honestly the prices charged for that setup were way too high. wouldn't bother coming back again unless things change pretty drastically.
Just checked in a couple days back and the breakfast food quality was top notch with SO many different style options to choose from.

just checked in here last night and wow, what a great spot to unwind. the breakfast bar had some tasty coffee and pastries for the price but there were barely any hot food choices to pick from. the bed was okay, nothing too fancy but it got the job done for a few hours of sleep. everyone i ran into was super friendly and helped me sort out my luggage without any fuss.

the breakfast spread had so many options and honestly wasn't pricey for the quality of food, especially the hot items. love how the rooms feature those sleek dark wood accents. being right by the main strip made getting to dinner super easy. plus the area felt safe enough to walk around late at night.

i was worried about the price being a bit steep but honestly the bed was super comfy and the check-in was a breeze.
